name: Policy Gradients
learningObjectives: Understand the difference between value-based and policy-based methods
Learn how policy gradient methods directly optimize the policy
Understand the REINFORCE algorithm and Monte Carlo policy gradients
Learn about variance reduction techniques using baselines
Interpret policy probability distributions and stochastic policies
Recognize advantages of policy gradients for continuous action spaces

controls.label: Environment
controls.tooltip: Choose a grid-world environment with different obstacles and rewards

controls.label: Learning Rate (α)
controls.tooltip: Step size for policy updates. Policy gradients typically use smaller learning rates than Q-learning.

controls.label: Discount Factor (γ)
controls.tooltip: How much the agent values future rewards. Policy gradients often use higher discount factors.

controls.label: Use Baseline
controls.tooltip: Subtract mean return as baseline to reduce variance in gradient estimates.

controls.label: Training Episodes
controls.tooltip: Number of episodes to train the agent. Policy gradients may need more episodes than Q-learning.

controls.label: Max Steps per Episode
controls.tooltip: Maximum number of steps allowed in each episode before timeout.

visualizations.title: Reward per Episode
visualizations.description: Line chart showing total reward accumulated in each training episode

visualizations.title: Steps per Episode
visualizations.description: Line chart showing number of steps taken to reach the goal in each episode

visualizations.title: Policy Loss
visualizations.description: Line chart showing the policy gradient loss over training

visualizations.title: Policy Visualization
visualizations.description: Heatmap showing action probabilities for each state, visualizing the learned stochastic policy

visualizations.title: Environment with Optimal Path
visualizations.description: Grid visualization showing the environment and the path taken by the learned policy

metrics.name: Average Reward (Last 10 Episodes)
metrics.description: Mean total reward over the last 10 training episodes

metrics.name: Average Steps (Last 10 Episodes)
metrics.description: Mean number of steps to reach goal over the last 10 episodes

metrics.name: Optimal Path Length
metrics.description: Number of steps in the path taken by the learned policy

metrics.name: Success Rate
metrics.description: Percentage of last 10 episodes where the agent reached the goal

metrics.name: Average Policy Loss
metrics.description: Mean policy gradient loss over recent training steps

metrics.name: Baseline Enabled
metrics.description: Whether baseline variance reduction is being used
